When a coordinator fails, the copies pick a new leader.
After the election finishes, reads might still show old data.
The payment handler will not double-charge only if requests use the original idempotency key.
If a client times out, you do not know if the first charge went through.
If you retry with a new key, the safety guarantee does not apply, and it can make a second charge.
Backpressure slows down incoming new requests while the waiting queue clears; it does not stop or drop requests that were already accepted.
